description: Election Commission - Mr. A. L. Irufan Ali has Ceased to be a member of the United People's Freedom Alliance of the Matale Municipal Council - Mrs. L. G. I. K. Lolugaswala has Ceased to be a member of the United People's Freedom Alliance
reasoning: This gazette contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of local government bodies (Matale Municipal Council and Matale Pradeshiya Sabha) due to ceasing membership in a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral matters including vacating of offices.
